situation (example wording): A follow-up the rule-based rewriter cannot place, rewritten by a model: "Can you do rates instead of counts?", "show the same chart for Chicago"
what the app does today: P69: a follow-up the rewriter cannot place is asked about.
proposed behavior: Amends P69. A rewrite the rule-based rewriter places with certainty runs directly. A model's rewrite is proposed instead: "Did you mean: <question>?", with Run and Edit; nothing runs until the user confirms or edits it, and an edited question runs as a new question. A follow-up neither can place is still asked about. A model never changes only the presentation: chart and table edits are the rule-based rewriter's.
exact default or choices offered: Propose model rewrites for confirmation; run rule-based rewrites directly.
why: Tested in the shadow (Gemini 3.8 Flash): 4 of 50 hand-checked model rewrites changed the meaning ("Please do that!", "new orleans ori", "what rate is this?", "since 2019"), and on LS-422 the model replaced two places where the label asks. Shown first, each is a suggestion the user can fix, not a wrong answer.
status: Decided 2026-10-31 (Jeff, through the coordinator: "yes to both"); chart and table edits are declined in one sentence by P157 (cleanup 2026-11-22), audit B26, C21
test cases: No test found: no test cites this row or asks its example question.
